mcqs.question: The first phase of Census 2027, known as House Listing and Housing Census (HLHC), is scheduled for which period?
options: Up to 15 days before field work
mcqs.explanation: The first phase, House Listing and Housing Census (HLHC), is scheduled from April to September 2026. February 2027 is the schedule for the second phase, Population Enumeration; the other options refer to self-enumeration timing and the previous caste enumeration.
